author: driver
content: Observed: B550 Extreme4 and X570 Phantom Gaming 4 ROMs both have NULL zen_generation for all BHD/BL2 (BIOS-side) directory entries — 499 entries total in the test corpus. PSPTool only attaches zen_generation to PSP directories via PSP IDs; BIOS directories carry no such metadata. The agesa_version fallback returns 'AGESA_UNKNOWN' for these ROMs. One fix: infer generation from other entries in the same ROM (if all PSP entries in the same image are zen3, BHD entries should be too). Another: accept that BIOS-side entries are architecturally unclassified and filter them out of the 'select' pipeline, only tracking PSP-side entries per the primary research goal.
